title: I Gave a Restaurant One Star for Cold Soup ⭐
description:
This story may be inspired by real events or jokes, but all names and details are fictional. Any resemblance to real people is coincidental.

#funny #storytime #restaurant #shorts
style: 3D animated cartoon movie style, expressive characters with big eyes, vibrant colours, cinematic lighting, vertical composition, highly detailed, no text, no letters, no watermark

scenes.text: I ordered the fanciest soup on the menu. Twenty-eight dollars. And it came out completely cold.
scenes.image: a grumpy food critic woman about 35 with a notebook and cat-eye glasses at a fancy restaurant table frowning at a bowl of red soup

scenes.text: I didn't complain. I went home and wrote the angriest review of my life. One star. Cold soup. Embarrassing.
scenes.image: a grumpy food critic woman about 35 with a notebook and cat-eye glasses typing furiously on a laptop at home, one star on the screen

scenes.text: The next morning, the restaurant replied. Publicly.
scenes.image: a phone screen showing a review reply notification, a grumpy food critic woman about 35 with a notebook and cat-eye glasses raising an eyebrow

scenes.text: It said: Dear customer. You ordered gazpacho.
scenes.image: close-up of a phone screen with a polite reply, a grumpy food critic woman about 35 with a notebook and cat-eye glasses confused

scenes.text: I googled it. Gazpacho is a Spanish soup. It's supposed to be cold.
scenes.image: a grumpy food critic woman about 35 with a notebook and cat-eye glasses reading a search result, face turning red with embarrassment

scenes.text: Thousands of people liked their reply. I was famous for all the wrong reasons.
scenes.image: phones everywhere showing the review reply, people laughing

scenes.text: Then a package arrived at my door. From the chef.
scenes.image: a grumpy food critic woman about 35 with a notebook and cat-eye glasses opening a package at her door

scenes.text: Inside was a bowl of hot tomato soup. And a dictionary.
scenes.image: a grumpy food critic woman about 35 with a notebook and cat-eye glasses holding a dictionary and a steaming bowl, a proud restaurant chef with a big mustache and a tall white hat winking in a little photo card
